# DADS Minimal Excerpt Fixture (`dads-excerpt`)

- **Source repository**: `digital-go-jp/design-tokens` (Digital Agency Design System / デジタル庁デザインシステム)
- **Package / version**: `@digital-go-jp/design-tokens` v2.1.0
- **License**: MIT
- **Scope**: Minimal test excerpt only (NOT a vendored copy of the full DADS token set). Contains a small subset of colours (including Blue-900 `#0017C1` and Blue-50 `#E8F1FE`), a compact typography scale, and format-only `layouts.yaml` / `styles.yaml` examples for regression testing.
